questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of 'Equipercentile Equating' used by IBPS in multi-session examinations?
options: To increase the number of questions
To ensure fairness and consistency across different test sessions
To speed up the exam process
To reduce the number of exam centers
questions.explanation: Equipercentile equating is a statistical method used to maintain comparability of scores across multiple versions or sessions of an examination.

questions.question_text: What is the role of the 'Design & Analysis' (D&A) division at IBPS?
options: Designing and developing ability tests and answer keys
questions.explanation: The D&A division is responsible for developing tests, validating items, and finalizing answer keys for result processing.

questions.question_text: What is the primary role of the Design & Analysis (D&A) division at IBPS?
questions.explanation: The D&A division is responsible for creating and validating test batteries and finalizing answer keys.

questions.question_text: What does the 'Equipercentile Equating' method in IBPS exams aim to achieve?
options: Reduce the number of exam centers
Make the paper easier to read
questions.explanation: Equipercentile equating helps ensure that candidates are evaluated fairly even if different test sessions have varying difficulty levels.

questions.question_text: Which division at IBPS manages candidate data prior to assessment and result processing?
questions.explanation: TSS handles online application data, examination processing, and result generation.

questions.question_text: What are the three core values (foundational pillars) of IBPS mentioned in its philosophy?
questions.explanation: These are the traditional core values established by the founder Director Dr. A.S. Deshpande.

questions.question_text: The Research and Development (R&D) division at IBPS is known for conducting which types of assessments?
questions.explanation: The R&D division focuses on managerial potential through simulation-based tools like Group Exercises and Assessment Centres.

questions.question_text: Which division manages the 'Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism'?
questions.explanation: The F&AS division includes a section dedicated to coordinating candidate grievance redressal.

questions.question_text: Who is currently the Executive Head and Member Secretary of the IBPS Governing Board?
questions.explanation: The Director of the Institute is the Executive Head and Member Secretary of the Governing Board.
